localFacts.fact: Berlin Brandenburg Film Commission: filming on public streets that goes beyond normal common use (Gemeingebrauch) needs a Sondernutzung from the district; the simpler Miniteam permit covers max. 5 people, max. 1 camera tripod and no lighting set-ups. A dolly move on the pavement can push a shoot past that. General information, not legal advice.
BBFC: using public street land without the permit, or breaking its conditions, is an administrative offence with a fine of up to 10.000 (currency not to be printed in the post: say 'ein Bußgeld').
Lufthansa allows a cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm; the folding clamp dollies (K&F 38,5 cm, SmallRig 43 cm, NEEWER 45 cm folded) fit that length, the Manfrotto 114 (64,7 cm closed) does not.
Local terms: Stativ-Dolly / Stativrollwagen, Rollen, Feststellbremse, Spikes vs. Gummifüße, Kamerafahrt, Dolly-Schiene; amazon.de titles the NEEWER as 'Fotografie Stativ Dolly'.

localPainPoints.pain: Wobbly footage even on laminate, despite the 3 in wheels.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep moves slow on hard floors, use rubber wheels of 3 in or more, record sound separately, and use track (Glide Gear SYL 960 track wheels or Proaim track wheels) for steady moves (English post).

quotes.text: jedoch habe ich schon auf normalen Laminat sehr wackelige Aufnahmen. Sehr schade, trotz der größeren Rollen.

localPainPoints.pain: Wheels too hard for camera moves.
localPainPoints.fix: Treat a clamp dolly as a way to reposition the tripod and for slow moves; for real tracking shots use dolly track or a slider (English post).

quotes.text: aber die Rollen sind viel zu hart für jeden Untergrund. Kamerafahrten sind damit nicht möglich.

localPainPoints.pain: Clamps and set-up: owners want the tripod feet to sit firmly and set-up to be quick.
localPainPoints.fix: Tighten every clamp at shooting height (English post); one German owner says the clamps sit perfectly and set-up is very fast.
